Many thanks, Michael!

Subject: Re: Follow-up Briefing
Dear colleagues,
Thankyouvery much for the time and informative conversation on Friday. We clearly share many of the same concerns
regarding closing civic space in northern Central America, and hope we can work together to address them.
By way of follow up as discussed, we would be grateful for the following:
1) A catalogue of the trainings (e.g. on Meta's content moderation standards) that were mentioned/offered during the
briefing on Friday; and
2) Point(s) of contact for follow-up on specific issues for the team here in Washington and our Missions in El Salvador,
Guatemala, and Honduras.
Thanks again,

Michael
Michael Camilleri
Senior Advisor to the Administrator
E ecutive Director, Northern Triangle Task Force
U S Agency for International Development (USAID)

On Fri, Jun 17, 2022 at 2:06 PM Michael Camilleri <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Sandra,
You read my mind... or at least my to do list!
Very much looking forward to setting this up. I'm out on the 27th but we could schedule for later that week if you're
amenable. Copying my colleagues Cara and Emma who have spearheaded the Voices initiative we announced at the
Summit. They can help us coordinate schedules and will likely pull in a few Mission colleagues as well.
Separately, USAID is currently doing a digital ecosystem assessment in Honduras with a team from DAI Global. They
were looking to speak with Meta and reached out to Glenda Michel. Is Glenda the right person or is there another POC
you can suggest for this?
Many thanks!
Michael
Michael Camilleri
Senior Advisor to the Administrator
E ecutive Director, Northern Triangle Task Force
U S Agency for International Development (USAID)
[contact omitted] gov
On Fri, Jun 17, 2022 at 1:45 PM Sandra Luff < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Good afternoon, Michael.

I hope this finds you well — especially after the very hectic week in LA!
I wanted to follow-up on our discussion to schedule a meeting where we could dive deeper into the
Northern Triangle. If possible, we would like to offer Monday, June 27th (perhaps late morning or early
afternoon EST) to schedule the briefing. I've ce'd my colleagues who would attend along with Becky
Moore to help schedule.
Please let us know if you have any availability to meet and know we look forward to continuing our
conversation.
Many thanks & best for a great weekend!
Sandy
